scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Current official public-charging page explicitly separates ad-hoc charging from the Stadtwerke Wesel contract card. Ad-hoc: AC 0.50 EUR/kWh plus 0.05 EUR/min after 240 min during 08:00-18:00; DC 0.59 EUR/kWh plus 0.20 EUR/min after 120 min. QR/app direct payment is documented.

Current official medl-eTanke page publishes Direct Payment at 0.44 EUR/kWh, no start fee and no blocking fee, specifically for medl-eTanke units equipped with a display. The page explicitly warns that non-display units can have different QR/app prices, so the tariff is scoped only to display-equipped medl EVSEs and is not generalized beyond that subset.

Current official public-charging page has a dedicated Ad-hoc section: AC 0.77 EUR/kWh, DC 0.87 EUR/kWh, DC start fee 5.00 EUR, plus 0.10 EUR/min blocking after 240 min AC or 120 min DC capped at 12 EUR per session. QR/app direct payment is explicitly documented.

Official current Stadtwerke Herne material confirms that the utility built and operates a public charging network in Herne (historically 69 public charge points and continuing expansion), but the current public website surfaces wallbox/business charging solutions rather than a numeric ad-hoc/public tariff. No current exact direct-payment price was established in this first pass.
this_pass.reason: public CPO activity confirmed, but no current official numeric ad-hoc tariff or station-level public checkout matrix surfaced

The station observations are therefore not generalized.
this_pass.reason: operator and public network confirmed; station-level direct prices vary and no current official universal/direct matrix was established
